UNESCO Heritage Spotlight

Discover Ajanta & Ellora

Experience two of Maharashtra's most remarkable heritage destinations with private transportation and a flexible itinerary designed around your travel plans.

Key Circuit Destinations Included:

  • Ajanta Caves (UNESCO World Heritage Buddhist murals)
  • Ellora Caves (Kailasa Temple - Monolithic rock marvel)
  • Daulatabad Fort (Medieval impregnable hill fortress)
  • Bibi Ka Maqbara (17th-century Mughal heritage)
  • Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Gateway & historic city)

Popular Destinations

View All Destinations
Ajanta Caves

World Heritage Buddhist Rock-Cut Cave Monasteries

A world-renowned UNESCO site dating back to 2nd century BCE, famous for breathtaking ancient frescoes, murals, and carved stone stupas.

approx. 100 km (2 to 2.5 hours scenic drive)
Explore DestinationAsk Taxi Quote
Ellora Caves

Monolithic Architectural Marvel of Ancient India

Home to the astonishing Kailasa Temple (Cave 16), carved top-down from a single massive rock mountain monolith.

approx. 30 km (45 minutes drive)
Explore DestinationAsk Taxi Quote
Bibi Ka Maqbara

The Taj of the Deccan

Strikingly reminiscent of the Taj Mahal, this historic Mughal monument features intricate stucco work, manicured gardens, and marble domes.

Within city limits (approx. 5 km from city center)
Explore DestinationAsk Taxi Quote
Daulatabad Fort

Invincible Medieval Fortress on Deogiri Hill

A legendary fortress standing atop a steep conical hill, featuring moats, bastions, Chand Minar tower, and a dark trap passage.

approx. 16 km (25-30 minutes drive en route to Ellora)
Explore DestinationAsk Taxi Quote
Shirdi

Sacred Spiritual Destination of Sai Baba

Holy town dedicated to the reverence of 19th-century saint Sai Baba, located within easy driving distance from Aurangabad.

approx. 110 km (2 to 2.5 hours drive)
Explore DestinationAsk Taxi Quote
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

Tourism Capital of Maharashtra

The gateway city to Ajanta and Ellora, rich in Mughal, Maratha, and ancient Buddhist history.

Simple & Transparent Process

How It Works

From your initial enquiry to your final journey drop-off, our process is designed for clarity, punctuality, and complete peace of mind.

01

Share Your Requirements

Submit travel dates, number of travelers, preferred destinations and transportation needs via form, WhatsApp or phone.

02

Discuss Your Trip

We review your specific preferences, vehicle choices, timing, and budget considerations in direct conversation.

03

Receive Your Customized Quote

We craft and present a suitable itinerary and transparent, itemized quote based on your exact details.

04

Confirm Your Journey

Once you approve the itinerary and price, your reservation is confirmed and vehicle/driver is assigned.

05

Travel With Confidence

Enjoy clean private transportation, courteous driver support, and continuous local assistance throughout your trip.
